dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently match the stated purpose: fetching GitHub PR/issue metadata, analyzing duplicate PRs and missing issue links, verifying evidence, reporting findings, and optionally posting reviewed comments.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Use is limited to explicit cross-reference requests for a named repository, starts in report-only mode, treats repository content as untrusted, and requires review before action.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation is a normal ClawHub install or manual clone/symlink; there are no install-time hooks, background services, or hidden setup steps.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses gh, jq, local workspace files, GitHub API access, and many subagents; this is proportionate for repository auditing, but private repository metadata will be processed by the configured agent runtime.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No credentials are stored and no background persistence is present; the only persistence is local run output and comment progress files, while GitHub comment posting requires both approved-comments.json and --execute.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[LP3] expected: The lack of a formal permissions declaration is a reviewability gap, but the artifacts plainly disclose GitHub API reads, workspace writes, subagent analysis, and approval-gated comment posting, so this does not justify Review by itself.
[staticScan.clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, and manual inspection found only purpose-aligned shell scripts for data fetching, validation, dry-run behavior, and approved comment posting.
[VirusTotal.clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry showed no malicious or suspicious engine detections; this supports but does not determine the benign verdict.
llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable letting the skill read PR and issue metadata from the named repository and send compact indexes to subagents. Use a read-only GitHub token for analysis, grant write access only for an approved posting run, and review every generated comment before creating the approval file and running with --execute.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed GitHub repository analysis helper that reads PR and issue data and only posts comments after explicit approval.
